# trufflehog --exclude-paths list for ci.yml's security-scan job.
#
# One regex per line, matched against each file's path in the repo. trufflehog
# applies this to every commit it walks for a given run (ci.yml's `--since-commit`
# scoping decides which commits that is — a diff against the PR's base branch,
# or HEAD~1 on a push to main), not just the current tree, so a path here
# stays suppressed for any old/stale commit that run reaches, not only new ones.
#
# Every entry below is a client-embedded Firebase/Google Maps config file
# that ships inside the built mobile app bundle by design (Expo/RN requires
# committing these for `expo prebuild`/EAS builds) — the keys inside are not
# server secrets and are already effectively public once the app is
# published, restricted (or restrictable) via Google Cloud Console API
# key restrictions rather than secrecy. Decided 2026-09-23 (issue #5694):
# allowlist without rotation, since these keys are client-side config, not
# credentials with server-side privilege.
#
# Accepted risk / re-review trigger: this is a path-based exclusion, so it
# also suppresses trufflehog on any FUTURE content added to these exact
# paths — if one of these files (esp. eas.json, which can carry EAS build
# secrets/env vars beyond Firebase config) ever gains a genuine server
# credential, this list stops catching it. Re-review this list if that
# usage changes.
^driver-app/google-services\.json$
^rider-app/google-services\.json$
^driver-app/GoogleService-Info\.plist$
^rider-app/GoogleService-Info\.plist$
^driver-app/eas\.json$
^rider-app/eas\.json$
^shared/config/firebaseConfig\.ts$

# Dead scratch scripts that hardcoded a Maps API key, committed under the
# already-fully-deprecated frontend/ prototype (see frontend/DEPRECATED.md)
# and an old driver-app/ path. The driver-app/ copies are already deleted
# from the current tree; the frontend/ copies are deleted in the same PR
# that added this list. Kept here because trufflehog still walks the
# commits where they existed.
^driver-app/test-places\.js$
^driver-app/test-maps\.js$
^frontend/test-places\.js$
^frontend/test-maps\.js$
